name: a terminal command types in and confirms shipped work
looks: A small dark terminal window sits alone on a near-black field as a command types itself in; two check-marked lines confirm tasks underneath, one of them tagged "shipped" in the accent colour.
build: glass-ui-flow's typing pattern in a terminal chrome: the command types on at a steady rate with a blinking caret, the confirm lines fading in with their check icons popping in on back.out right after.
sound: A soft typing clack, a light chime on each check.
prompt: Open on a small terminal window alone on a dark field, a command typing itself in. Follow it with a couple of check-marked status lines confirming work is done, one tagged with a short status word in the accent colour. Keep it quiet and technical, the first proof point of the film.
